verdict.rationale: Clerk documents API keys and M2M tokens for authenticating programmatic callers and calls between agents, metered as a machine-authentication feature. Scoping is supported through OAuth scoped access, custom OAuth scopes for MCP clients, and gating agent tool calls against the caller's permissions and scopes. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that individual API keys/M2M tokens can be restricted to specific scopes or permissions, details on expiry and revocation of agent credentials, and independent hands-on corroboration.
